Dex Description: Mangroknob is most often found around mangrove roots and brackish forest in Mirefen. It survives by adapting quickly to changes in food, terrain, and nearby monster activity.

Name: Baritonose
Habitat / Ecology: toxic mangrove basins and miasma roots
Migration Pattern: Dominant troop movement after miasma blooms
Concept Summary: Miasma caller exhaling poison through an enormous resonant nasal chamber.
Dex Description: Researchers most often encounter Baritonose around toxic mangrove basins and miasma roots. It produces carefully controlled toxins that become stronger under stress.

Name: Umbrelloom
Habitat / Ecology: soft abyss sediment and cold cave water
Concept Summary: Dumbo-octopus-inspired abyss drifter with ear fins and umbrella web between arms.
Dex Description: Around soft abyss sediment and cold cave water, Umbrelloom is a familiar sight in The Deep. It can slip partly into spectral currents when startled or pursuing prey.

Name: Abyssbell
Habitat / Ecology: hadal rift mouths and pressure void chambers
Concept Summary: Epic hadal oracle with huge bell web, ear fins and luminous arm tips.
Dex Description: Abyssbell is most often found around hadal rift mouths and pressure void chambers in The Deep. It can slip partly into spectral currents when startled or pursuing prey.

Name: Epochshield
Habitat / Ecology: ancient tidal works and rusted floodgates
Concept Summary: Horseshoe-crab-inspired relic shield with alloy-like dome and long rigid telson.
Dex Description: Researchers most often encounter Epochshield around ancient tidal works and rusted floodgates. It continually reinforces its body with new layers of resilient chitin.

Name: Simiri
Habitat / Ecology: old fruit groves, beginner forest routes, shrine orchards
Migration Pattern: Small troop movements between fruit trees
Concept Summary: Adaptive fantasy monkey with expressive ears, dexterous hands and spiral prehensile tail; base for permanent material branches.
Dex Description: Around old fruit groves, beginner forest routes, shrine orchards, Simiri is a familiar sight in Greenreach. It survives by adapting quickly to changes in food, terrain, and nearby monster activity.

Name: Cinderimi
Habitat / Ecology: warm shrine groves and ember orchards
Concept Summary: Fire branch of Simiri; same monkey anatomy with flame crest, ember forearms and coal-ring tail.
Dex Description: Cinderimi is most often found around warm shrine groves and ember orchards in Dragonspine. It stores intense heat in specialized tissues and vents it when threatened.

Name: Brookimi
Concept Summary: Water branch of Simiri with fin-cheek tufts, slick fur and paddle-like spiral tail membrane.
Dex Description: Researchers most often encounter Brookimi around river shrines and waterfall groves. It senses subtle shifts in pressure and current long before most creatures notice them.

Name: Bramblemi
Concept Summary: Grass branch of Simiri with leaf mane, bark wrist guards and vine-wrapped spiral tail.
Dex Description: Around ancient orchards and vine shrines, Bramblemi is a familiar sight in Greenreach. It draws nutrients and ambient magic through living growths across its body.

Name: Voltimiri
Habitat / Ecology: charged canopy towers and storm orchards
Concept Summary: Electric branch with conductor fur, lightning ear tufts and charged tail rings.
Dex Description: Voltimiri is most often found around charged canopy towers and storm orchards in Stormpeak. It stores electrical charge in specialized organs and releases it in controlled bursts.

Name: Rimeiri
Habitat / Ecology: frost orchards and snow shrine groves
Concept Summary: Ice branch with crystal brow tufts, frost-padded hands and icy spiral tail.
Dex Description: Researchers most often encounter Rimeiri around frost orchards and snow shrine groves. It regulates its body temperature by forming a thin layer of magical rime.

Name: Omeniri
Concept Summary: Ghost branch with translucent hands, wispy crown and tail fading into echo rings.
Dex Description: Around abandoned shrines and moonless orchards, Omeniri is a familiar sight in The Rift. It can slip partly into spectral currents when startled or pursuing prey.

Name: Noctimiri
Habitat / Ecology: black-fruit groves and drowned shrine canopy
Concept Summary: Dark branch with black quill mane, crescent eye mask and heavy shadow spiral tail.
Dex Description: Noctimiri is most often found around black-fruit groves and drowned shrine canopy in Mirefen. It relies on concealment, patience, and opportunistic movement rather than direct pursuit.

Name: Alloymiri
Habitat / Ecology: forge shrines and old rail orchards
Concept Summary: Steel branch with fitted keratin plates, plated forearms and gear-ring tail.
Dex Description: Researchers most often encounter Alloymiri around forge shrines and old rail orchards. Dense metallic structures grow across the parts of its body that take the most strain.

Name: Oraciri
Habitat / Ecology: resonance shrines and crystal fruit groves
Concept Summary: Psychic branch with crystal brow prism, floating finger-rings and orbiting tail sigils.
Dex Description: Around resonance shrines and crystal fruit groves, Oraciri is a familiar sight in Crystal Depths. It is unusually sensitive to thoughts, memory, and magical resonance.

Name: Aurevine
Habitat / Ecology: root sanctuaries, ancient exchange groves, restored deepwood vaults
Concept Summary: An ivory-and-emerald serpentine stag guardian with leaf antlers, a gold balance crest and luminous vine ribbons. It embodies exchange that restores ecological balance instead of stripping value from a habitat.
Dex Description: Aurevine appears where trade and habitat fall out of balance. The luminous vines around its antlers brighten when a bargain restores more than it takes.

Name: Tempestyr
Habitat / Ecology: crown conductor ruins, thunder summits, storm-anchor spires
Concept Summary: A deep-teal storm drake with lightning antlers, a gold exchange crest and a mane that breaks into blue-white arcs. It embodies decisive choices and the consequences that follow them.
Dex Description: Tempestyr gathers at storm anchors before choices that can reshape a region. Its golden crest flashes the instant a trainer commits to a decision they cannot simply undo.
